# PubmedPlot

The goal of PubmedPlot is to plot the number of publications in Pubmed
over time.

## Credits

- [@MR_lit](https://twitter.com/Mendelian_lit) for original idea and
  code

## Installation

You can install the development version of PubmedPlot like so:

``` r

remotes::install_github("explodecomputer/PubmedPlot")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`group_by_time_interval()`](https://explodecomputer.github.io/PubmedPlot/reference/group_by_time_interval.md)
  : Organise results into counts by time interval
- [`plot_time_interval()`](https://explodecomputer.github.io/PubmedPlot/reference/plot_time_interval.md)
  : Plot the results of the search
- [`search_term()`](https://explodecomputer.github.io/PubmedPlot/reference/search_term.md)
  : Search for a term in the database.
- [`search_term_by_year()`](https://explodecomputer.github.io/PubmedPlot/reference/search_term_by_year.md)
  : Search for a term in the database, split up by year.
